title: Whom to visit when officers are few: analysis code
description: Analysis code for a study of credit follow-up under a fixed field-staff capacity on 1,496,721 Thai rice-cultivating borrowers (2020-2022, 2022 withheld): ranking rules, mixed small-loan policy, points scorecard, price of transparency, PSI/CSI monitoring and scorecard deployment. Borrower records are restricted and not included; a synthetic panel generator is provided.
